title: News on the Water
offer: A good trader asks before she sells. Hail three boats on the lakes and ask about the price of wool. Then sell a crate of wool where it pays.

says: Wool? They always need it at the weaver in Guldvik.
The market in Kråkhamn buys wool too, they say.
steps.say: Now you know more than most traders! Sell your wool where they want it.
Good soft wool! I will spin it into yarn and weave it into cloth. Thank you.

fact: News travelled with the boats: a skipper who knew the prices was worth a lot.
